survive_rule: bytes survive; crawlers do not re-expand
cold_multi_shelf_rule: Planes A/B/C: A=one CF/GitHub tunnel (5 surfaces / 2 family radii, not 5 shelves); B=alt independent forge/archive tip-pack SLOT; C=USB airgap SLOT. Survival = bytes↔hash. LIVE only after hash verify.
cross_network_survival_rule: If network + live data die tomorrow, the chain still survives via cold copies across independent shelves; survival = bytes↔hash.
no_lie_no_rewrite_rule: receipts that still hash; copies not all on one tunnel; verify without voice; no rewrite key; network never lies even to stay alive.

foldlock.redline: Never fold the lockset tip hash itself. Never rewrite the chain. Tip SHA-256 stays over raw receipts. Folding is a suppression aid, not encryption and not zip.
